maria: Quick heads-up — I'll be handing off evening oncall in 20m. Do a quick access smoke: VPN, pager test, runbook link below. If you're covering, lmk here. https://redwood.infra/runbooks/oncall-evening
aj: on it. VPN works for me — just reauth'd. Pager is provisioned for me (confirmed via OpsPager). Runbook link opens.
oncall-bot: Pager assigned: @aj for 2026-03-17 00:00-08:00 UTC
cheng: Quick check — can folks confirm they can view the runbook section "kv cache warmup" (sometimes 403)?
maria: yes I can view kv cache warmup. If you see 403, try incognito or use SSO link: https://sso.redwood/redirect
samg: I can't pull the runbook — hitting 403. Reauthing now.
lena: VPN ok, but I don't have pager access (page doesn't appear in OpsPager). @aj do you see me in the schedule?
aj: I see lena as on-call backup in the roster UI. If you're missing pager, PM me and I'll escalate with infra. Also run:
```bash
# quick vpn test
ping -c 3 dev-gw.redwood.local
# pager ping
curl -X POST https://ops-pager/api/test-ping -d '{"target":"lena"}'
```
maria: also FYI — credentials for jump host are in 1Password folder 'Oncall/Evening' (read-only for SRE). Make sure you can ssh: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall_id rsa oncall@jump.redwood`
samg: ssh works after I rotated my key. Pager test succeeded.
cheng: All good here. One small note: the 'restarts' runbook step has a typo in service name; I'll leave a quick PR after handoff.
aj: thanks — if anything critical pops, default fallback is model-variant routing to small-gpu pool per runbook.
maria: Perfect. Tagging final handoff: handing to @aj, backup @lena. I'll be reachable +1hr. :thumbsup:
aj: Taking it. Good luck! :raised_hands:
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from maria to aj at 2026-03-17T00:00:00Z
